comments.body:
+1 Throwing
+1 Trap
requires 10000 fame to equip

25x Steel, 10x Lumber, 1x Improved Steel Sheet using r8 casting. Hong Xing has the recipe.

To recruit Hong Xing to your colony, you do the immigration quest "Hot-blooded craftsman" from Western Europe, which requires you to deliver 20 muskets to Hanyang.

It may help (or may not, who knows) to do the follow up immigration quest from Western Europe to deliver 50 iron ore to your colony.

part of the memorial album Immigration Attraction (No.2)
